scene.assetVerificationNote: experimental derived workload; source and derived manifests must both be checked
scene.lightingNote: Architectural reference study, no candle geometry or candle lights. Night uses 14 finite-radius point lights without point-shadow occlusion; not a recreation of Unreal GI.
scene.referenceNote: Manual match to supplied daylight frame; original camera, exposure and GI settings unavailable. Not a pixel-identical recreation.
scene.materialGraphNote: Library variants preserve imported textures, alpha, normal, roughness and metal maps. Wax and flame use constant surface outputs. Emission does not create light.

presentation: platform window; refresh pacing may cap throughput

renderSettings.gi: cached environment probes (fixed geometry / sun direction)
renderSettings.lightAttenuation: 3D finite-radius attenuation / (1 + distance squared); linear RGB; unshadowed
